desc:
💪 Train with dumbbells and grow stronger.
🦖 Head into the jungle and fight powerful dinosaurs.
🎒 Carry defeated dinos back to your base.
💰 Collect coins from your dinosaurs and upgrade your gear.
🏋️ Buy bigger dumbbells and gain Strength faster.
🔄 Rebirth for permanent Strength and Coin boosts.
🔥 Go deeper, defeat stronger dinos, and build the ultimate collection!
